en.title: Seoul stocks fall for 3rd day as Treasury yields rise
en.summary: South Korean stocks declined for a third consecutive session as rising US Treasury yields prompted concerns about borrowing costs and weakened investor confidence. The Korean won also depreciated against the US dollar.

stories.title: Jang Yoon-gi sentenced to life for murder of Gwangju student

en.title: Jang Yoon-gi sentenced to life for murder of Gwangju student
en.summary: A 23-year-old man received a life sentence for killing a 16-year-old high school student in Gwangju. The court also imposed electronic monitoring for 30 years and employment restrictions at institutions serving children and vulnerable populations for a decade.
